Removing support telemetry empties the executed history; using change counts yields [1,0] instead of five support cells; failure to settle or a fixture that never changes fails the two change assertions.

Counting excluded/common-SOL cells or publishing changes makes a nonzero support value fail the all-zero comparison; lack of a changing then settled trip fails the change assertions. zeros_like derives only expected shape, not expected values; missing support could make this comparison vacuous but the positive-support test independently refuses that regression.

Swapping the helper output produces 0 support versus the independent literal 345 and 345 changes versus literal 0; aliasing the outputs fails their inequality. Swapping only the production constructor keywords is missed, as finding 2 states.
Routing picard through active-set selection fails or loses its independent literal seven; returning a populated support array fails the zero-size assertion.

Publishing change counts or dropping the support history fails equality against the independently obtained solver history when their arrays differ; this only guards transport, not the numerical correctness of a shared sentinel.
